description: Add missing database indexes to prisma/schema.prisma for query optimization. Existing indexes cover basic queries but composite indexes are needed for dashboard, reports, and list views that filter on multiple columns. Add indexes for: Lead (status+priority+createdAt), CallLog (status+disposition+createdAt, leadId+disposition), FollowUp (dueAt+priority+status), User (status+roleId), LeadAssignment (toUserId+method+createdAt), Notification (userId+channel+status).
steps: Read prisma/schema.prisma to understand existing indexes (already has many single-column and two-column indexes on lines 236-940)
Add composite indexes to Lead model: @@index([status, priority, createdAt(sort: Desc)]) for filtered lead lists with priority sorting, @@index([city, state]) for location-based distribution queries
Add composite indexes to CallLog model: @@index([status, dispositionId, createdAt(sort: Desc)]) for call reports filtered by outcome, @@index([leadId, dispositionId]) for lead call history analysis
Add composite indexes to FollowUp model: @@index([dueAt, priority, status]) for prioritized follow-up queues
Add composite indexes to User model: @@index([status, roleId]) for active user listings by role, @@index([assignmentPaused, status]) for distribution eligibility checks
Add composite indexes to LeadAssignment model: @@index([toUserId, method, createdAt]) for assignment history by method
Add composite indexes to Notification model: @@index([userId, channel, status, createdAt(sort: Desc)]) for notification inbox queries
Add composite index to ImportBatch model: @@index([status, createdAt(sort: Desc)]) for import queue monitoring
Run npx prisma migrate dev --name add-composite-indexes to generate migration
Verify migration file created in prisma/migrations/
acceptance_criteria: All new indexes added to prisma/schema.prisma without breaking existing schema
Migration file generated successfully with no errors
npx prisma migrate dev completes without errors
Database schema updated with new indexes visible in npx prisma studio
verification: npx prisma validate - confirms schema is valid
npx prisma migrate dev --name add-composite-indexes - applies migration
npm run test - existing tests still pass
Verify migration file exists in prisma/migrations/ directory
